chunks.title: Fake hotel booking scams
search_text: hotel booking scam fake website how to avoid
arnaque réservation hôtel faux site
احتيال حجز فندق موقع مزيف
how to know if hotel booking is real
chunks.text: Fake hotel booking websites mimic real platforms. Always verify the URL, use trusted platforms like Booking.com or the hotel's official site, and avoid direct bank transfers. Scammers often use names similar to well-known hotels (e.g., 'Marriott Inn' instead of 'Marriott International').

chunks.title: Credit card fraud hotel payment
search_text: hotel payment credit card fraud risk
paiement hotel carte bancaire sécurité
احتيال بطاقة بنكية فندق الدفع
is it safe to pay hotel online
chunks.text: Use secure payment methods and avoid sharing card details via email or messaging apps. Prefer platforms with fraud protection. Never give your card to hotel staff for 'pre-authorization' without a receipt.

chunks.title: Phishing and email scams
search_text: hotel phishing emails fake confirmation
arnaque email réservation hôtel
احتيال بريد إلكتروني حجز فندق
fake hotel confirmation email
chunks.text: Phishing emails may ask for personal information or payment to 'confirm' a reservation. Always verify by calling the hotel directly using the number on their official website, not the one in the email.

chunks.title: AI-generated fake listings
search_text: AI fake hotel photos scam
arnaque photos hôtel IA
احتيال صور فندق ذكاء اصطناعي
how to spot AI fake hotel listing
chunks.text: Scammers use AI to create fake or heavily edited hotel photos. Cross-check with official websites, recent guest reviews, and platforms like Google Maps for real images.

chunks.title: Hotel guest rules Dubai (e.g., Burj Al Arab, Atlantis The Palm)
search_text: Dubai hotel guest rules visitors allowed
règles hôtel Dubai visiteurs chambre Burj Al Arab
قوانين فنادق دبي زوار برج العرب
can unmarried couples stay hotel Dubai Atlantis
chunks.text: Luxury hotels like Burj Al Arab and Atlantis The Palm require guests to present ID. Unmarried couples can stay together, but some budget hotels may ask for proof of marriage. Always check the hotel's policy before booking.

chunks.title: Hotel deposit and hidden fees (e.g., Jumeirah Beach Hotel)
search_text: Dubai hotel hidden charges fees Jumeirah
frais cachés hôtel Dubai Jumeirah Beach
رسوم فندق جميرا الشاطئ دبي مخفية
extra charges hotel Dubai Jumeirah
chunks.text: High-end hotels like Jumeirah Beach Hotel may require large deposits for incidentals. Always ask for a detailed breakdown of fees before paying, especially for resort or tourism taxes.

chunks.title: Hotel theft risks Paris (e.g., Hôtel de Crillon, Le Meurice)
search_text: hotel theft Paris safety tips valuables Hôtel de Crillon
vol hotel Paris sécurité objets valeur Le Meurice
سرقة فندق باريس نصائح كرليون
is hotel safe in Paris valuables luxury
chunks.text: Luxury hotels like Hôtel de Crillon and Le Meurice are generally safe, but theft can occur in rooms or lobbies. Use the in-room safe and never leave valuables unattended.

chunks.title: Fake concierge scams (e.g., Hôtel Ritz Paris)
search_text: hotel fake concierge scam Paris Ritz
arnaque concierge hôtel Paris Ritz
احتيال موظف الفندق باريس ريتز
hotel staff scam Paris luxury
chunks.text: Scammers may pose as concierges at luxury hotels like the Ritz, offering 'exclusive' tours or services. Always verify staff badges and never pay cash upfront for services.

رسوم فندق لاس فيغاس رسوم مخفية سيزرز

chunks.text: Luxury resorts like Bellagio and Caesars Palace charge daily resort fees (often $40–$50) for amenities like pools or gyms. These are rarely included in the initial booking price. Always ask for the total cost upfront.

vol hotel Bali chambre sécurité St. Regis

is Bali hotel safe valuables luxury

chunks.text: All-inclusive resorts like Rixos or Steigenberger use wristbands for access to food/drinks. Losing it may result in extra charges. Some hotels now use digital bracelets, but scammers still sell fake ones.

search_text: Egypt hotel beach safety Sharm Four Seasons

chunks.text: Hotels like Four Seasons or Hilton Sharm El Sheikh have private beaches, but accidents can happen. Check for lifeguards, warning flags, and avoid swimming alone or at night.

chunks.title: Overbooking and room downgrades (e.g., Times Square hotels)

why hotel downgraded my room New York
chunks.text: Hotels in Times Square often overbook. If they offer a 'free upgrade' or alternative hotel, confirm the new room's quality and location. Demand compensation if the new room is inferior.

chunks.text: Scammers create fake listings for iconic hotels like The Savoy or Claridge's. Always book through the hotel's official website or verified platforms like Booking.com. Beware of third-party sites offering unusually low rates.

chunks.title: Unlicensed minicabs at hotel exits (e.g., Heathrow, central London hotels)

chunks.text: Unlicensed minicabs often solicit guests outside London hotels, especially near Heathrow. Only use licensed black cabs or pre-booked apps like Uber or Bolt. Unlicensed drivers may overcharge or pose a safety risk.

chunks.title: Fake short-term rental scams (e.g., Darling Harbour, CBD hotels)

احتيال إيجار فندق سيدني مزيف

chunks.text: Scammers advertise fake Airbnb-style apartments near hotels in the CBD or Darling Harbour. Always verify listings through Airbnb or Booking.com, and confirm the address exists using Google Maps before transferring any money.

chunks.title: Credit card surcharges and hidden fees (e.g., The Langham, Park Hyatt Sydney)

frais cachés hôtel Sydney Park Hyatt
رسوم بطاقة فندق سيدني مخفية

chunks.text: Australian hotels often apply credit card surcharges (1–3%). Hotels like The Langham or Park Hyatt Sydney may also charge resort or parking fees not shown upfront. Always request a full cost breakdown before checking in.

chunks.title: Fake luxury hotel deals (e.g., Marina Bay Sands, Raffles Hotel)

arnaque fausse offre hôtel Singapour Raffles
احتيال عرض فندق سنغافورة رافلز
scam fake hotel deal Singapore luxury
chunks.text: Scammers advertise deeply discounted rates for premium hotels like Marina Bay Sands or Raffles. These deals are often distributed via SMS or social media. Only book through the hotel's official website or trusted OTAs.

chunks.title: GST and service charge confusion (e.g., Orchard Road hotels)
search_text: Singapore hotel GST service charge Orchard Road
frais service TVA hôtel Singapour
ضريبة خدمة فندق سنغافورة
hidden tax hotel Singapore
chunks.text: Singapore hotels apply a 9% GST and a 10% service charge, making the true price 19% higher than listed. Always look for the '+' signs after quoted prices and ask for the nett total before booking.

chunks.title: Fake historic hotel listings (e.g., Four Seasons Sultanahmet, Çırağan Palace)

arnaque faux hôtel Istanbul Çırağan Palace
احتيال قائمة فندق إسطنبول مزيفة
scam historic hotel booking Istanbul
chunks.text: Scammers impersonate prestigious Istanbul hotels like Four Seasons Sultanahmet or Çırağan Palace Kempinski, creating lookalike websites. Always check the URL matches the official domain and book through verified platforms.

chunks.title: Currency exchange scams near hotels (e.g., Grand Bazaar, Taksim)

arnaque change monnaie hôtel Istanbul Taksim
احتيال صرف العملة فندق إسطنبول
scam exchange rate hotel Istanbul
chunks.text: Unofficial money changers near hotels in Taksim or the Grand Bazaar area offer attractive rates but use rigged calculators or provide counterfeit bills. Use hotel exchange counters or licensed banks only.

scam canal hotel Amsterdam fake listing
chunks.text: Fake listings for canal-side or houseboat accommodations are common in Amsterdam. Always verify with platforms like Booking.com or the hotel's official site. Unique properties like houseboats require extra scrutiny.

chunks.title: Bicycle theft at hotel entrances (e.g., Leidseplein, Jordaan)

scam bike rental hotel Amsterdam
chunks.text: Bicycle theft near hotels in the Leidseplein or Jordaan areas is extremely common. If your hotel provides bike rental, ensure locks are provided. Never leave bikes unlocked or chained to light poles.

chunks.title: Hotel robbery and street crime (e.g., Copacabana Palace, Windsor Atlantica)

سرقة فندق ريو دي جانيرو كوباكابانا

chunks.text: Hotels near Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, like Copacabana Palace or Windsor Atlantica, are generally secure inside, but the surrounding streets carry elevated crime risks. Avoid carrying valuables on the beach and use hotel safes.

chunks.title: Fake hotel transport and tour scams (e.g., Carnival season)

احتيال وسائل نقل فندق ريو كرنفال

chunks.text: During Carnival, scammers posing as tour operators offer fake hotel-to-venue transport. Only book through your hotel's concierge or verified apps like 99 or Uber. Unofficial drivers often inflate prices dramatically.

chunks.title: Fake booking platforms (e.g., The Peninsula, InterContinental Hong Kong)

chunks.text: Scam platforms mimic booking sites for iconic hotels like The Peninsula or InterContinental Hong Kong. Always double-check the domain name and look for secure HTTPS connections before entering payment details.

chunks.title: Shopping scams linked to hotel concierge (e.g., Tsim Sha Tsui hotels)
search_text: Hong Kong hotel concierge shopping scam Tsim Sha Tsui

احتيال تسوق فندق هونغ كونغ

chunks.text: Some hotel concierges near Tsim Sha Tsui may receive commissions for directing guests to overpriced electronics or jewelry shops. Research independently before purchasing electronics or gemstones and compare prices online.

Always verify through official sites or platforms like Booking.com, and call the riad directly to confirm your reservation.

chunks.title: Guide and souk scams near hotels (e.g., Djemaa el-Fna area)
